title: phlomoides sarawschanica
intro: Phlomoides sarawschanica, commonly known as the  Phlomoides sarawschanica, is a flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Phlomoides sarawschanica include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, an expectorant, and a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions like asthma, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Phlomoides sarawschanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
